schemaNote: One entry per dataset. 'access' is one of: ultralytics (Ultralytics downloads it), huggingface (zip in the team's Hugging Face dataset repo), url (direct link), manual (a person must download it). Fill in downloadUrl or huggingFaceRepo, zipName and sha256 once the processed zip exists; common/datasets.py refuses to continue on a checksum mismatch and prints the real checksum when none is recorded. Never put tokens or Google Drive links with edit access in this file. Licence text is a practical reading of the published terms (plans/00-main-plan.md section 4), not legal advice.

datasets.name: brackish
datasets.description: Brackish underwater video frames, Aalborg University (Limfjorden, Denmark); Roboflow mirror has 14,674 images, YOLO format, 80/10/10 split
datasets.source: Aalborg University visual analysis group (vap.aau.dk); Roboflow mirror
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 on the Roboflow mirror (confirm at vap.aau.dk before mirroring)
datasets.redistribution: May be mirrored with attribution once the licence is confirmed
datasets.instructions: Download the YOLO-format export from the Roboflow mirror (needs a free Roboflow login) or from the AAU page, zip it as brackish.zip with the folders images/ and labels/ at the top level, upload it to the team's Hugging Face dataset repo, then fill in huggingFaceRepo, zipName and sha256 here. Check that near-identical frames from one video do not sit on both sides of the split (common/datasets.py findCrossSplitDuplicates).
datasets.conversionScript: common/datasets.py (label checks); the Roboflow export is already YOLO format

datasets.name: urpc
datasets.description: URPC underwater robot picking contest images; many near-duplicates, so deduplicate before training
datasets.source: URPC contest (official download closed); use a Roboflow copy or the cleaned DUO benchmark
datasets.license: Contest data; check the copy's README
datasets.instructions: Obtain a Roboflow copy of URPC (YOLO or VOC export). If it is VOC XML, convert with common/datasets.py convertVocXmlToYolo, then deduplicate with findNearDuplicateGroups and confirm findCrossSplitDuplicates returns nothing before training.

datasets.name: duo
datasets.description: DUO, a cleaned and deduplicated underwater detection benchmark (arXiv 2106.05681); the preferred second dataset
datasets.source: Liu et al., DUO benchmark (arXiv 2106.05681); check the paper for the download location
datasets.redistribution: No mirror until the licence is read
datasets.instructions: Download from the location given in the DUO paper, convert to YOLO format if needed, verify the class order against the label files, and record the licence here.
datasets.conversionScript: common/datasets.py convertVocXmlToYolo (if the release is VOC or COCO XML/JSON, adapt)

datasets.name: dawn
datasets.description: DAWN: about 1,000 real-traffic images in four weather sets (fog, rain, snow, sand)
datasets.license: All rights reserved; commercial use and distribution prohibited; images came from web searches
datasets.redistribution: Educational use only; no public mirror, keep processed copies private
datasets.instructions: Download DAWN from its Mendeley Data page, keep the four weather folders, and run weather/prepareDawn.py to convert to YOLO format and write the stratified 5-fold lists. Verify the class order in the supplied YOLO files first; classNames here follows the plan and must match them.

datasets.name: visdrone
datasets.description: VisDrone2019-DET: 6,471 train, 548 val, 1,610 test-dev images, 10 classes, large drone images
datasets.source: AISKYEYE, Tianjin University; Zhu et al., TPAMI 2021
datasets.license: Copyright AISKYEYE; secondary sources describe CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (official licence text not retrieved; confirm in the official VisDrone GitHub repo)
datasets.redistribution: Do not republish; attribute Zhu et al., TPAMI 2021
datasets.instructions: Nothing to download by hand: training with data='VisDrone.yaml' downloads about 2 GB and converts it. Allow about 4 GB of free disk space.

datasets.name: cod10k
datasets.description: COD10K camouflaged object dataset; only the 5,066 camouflaged images are used (3,040 train, 2,026 test)
datasets.source: Fan et al., COD10K authors' release
datasets.license: Research distribution by the authors; check the README
datasets.instructions: Download from the authors' release page, keep Train/Test image and GT folders, and confirm the file naming pattern that encodes the super-class (needed for the per-category analysis).

datasets.name: camo
datasets.description: CAMO camouflaged object dataset (1,000 train, 250 test)
datasets.source: Le et al., CAMO authors' release
datasets.license: Research distribution by the authors; check the README
datasets.instructions: Download from the authors' release page and keep the Train and Test folders with images and ground-truth masks.

datasets.name: nc4k
datasets.source: Lv et al., NC4K authors' release
datasets.license: Research distribution by the authors; check the README
datasets.instructions: Optional extra test set; download from the authors' release page.
